aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misidentifies the primary comparison and mixes diagnostic dimensions with repair/pickup outcomes.
issues: G1/G2/G3 are treated as changed conditions but appear to be mold subgroups.
Before vs after repair/design improvement is likely the main changed factor.
Tray 1/Tray 2 should be preserved as subgroup context, not hidden.
Dimension checks are diagnostic OK evidence, not clearly part of the same comparison.
Some measurement candidates appear parsed from headers or row ranges, not valid metrics.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the final case focus on before vs after frame-load-tray repair/design improvement?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as frame load tray repair/design improvement if full rows confirm it.
Use mold G1/G2/G3 and tray as subgroup keys where applicable.
Separate pre-repair mold/tray pickup diagnosis from after-repair validation outcome.
Keep dimension frame and tray checks as supporting diagnostic outcomes with OK judgement.
Remove header-derived measurement stats unless source rows show valid measured values and specs.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until full data rows and headings are rechecked.
